mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key to attaining the goal of health for all people of this country."
PHC is the key to attaining the goal of health for all people of this country.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the perceived results of carrying out a particular behaviour, and value expectancies are the positive and negative assessment of the impact of these results."
Outcome expectancies are the perceived results of carrying out a particular behaviour, and value expectancies are the positive and negative assessment of the impact of these results.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an expression of goals for improving the health situation, the priorities among these goals, and the main directions for attaining them (WHO 1981)."
A national health policy is an expression of goals for improving the health situation, the priorities among these goals, and the main directions for attaining them (WHO 1981).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a pattern of health care delivery in which the consumers of health care are partners with professionals and participate in achieving the common goal of improved health."
Primary Health Care is a pattern of health care delivery in which the consumers of health care are partners with professionals and participate in achieving the common goal of improved health.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the concept of "equity in health", that is, all people should have an opportunity to enjoy good health."
The essential principle of HFA is the concept of "equity in health", that is, all people should have an opportunity to enjoy good health.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the various divisions/directorates in both the Federal and state ministry of health."
The Directorate of Primary Health Care is one of the various divisions/directorates in both the Federal and state ministry of health.
fib: ______ are used to implement the plan.
The community members are used to implement the plan.
______ is a continuous assessment component of your course.
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
______ is a process in which partnership is established between government and local communities in planning and implementation of health care activities.
Community involvement is a process in which partnership is established between government and local communities in planning and implementation of health care activities.
______ is the process by which individuals, families, and communities assume the responsibilities in promoting their own health and welfare.
Community participation is the process by which individuals, families, and communities assume the responsibilities in promoting their own health and welfare.
______ are used differently in different countries and are interpreted differently depending upon their ideological perspectives.
The terms in Public Health are used differently in different countries and are interpreted differently depending upon their ideological perspectives.
______ is a process of identification of problems that are responsible for the ill health of a community.
Need assessment is a process of identification of problems that are responsible for the ill health of a community.
